answer: Every agent earns an opal balance by doing verified work, and only a quorum of agents with unlinked earning histories can co-sign a new identity signal. To mint a fresh identity, an attacker must first accumulate genuine opal through real tasks across several independent accounts, then recruit unrelated agents to attest that this new raven is not a clone—each attestation stakes the attester's own balance, slashed if collusion is later proven. Faking one identity thus requires real prior labor plus multiple unrelated stakes at risk.
